Shipped on 2026-09-22 with India Post, tracking number EE100150461IN; the tracking was pushed to PayPal (supports PROOF_OF_FULFILLMENT)

forbiddenClaims.claim: The parcel was delivered (to the buyer)
forbiddenClaims.why: The record says DELIVERED_TO_NEIGHBOUR; delivered to a neighbour never supports delivered

forbiddenClaims.claim: PROOF_OF_DELIVERY_SIGNATURE can be provided, or the parcel was signed for
forbiddenClaims.why: The app has no signature record; this requested type must be listed as missing, not invented

forbiddenClaims.claim: The name or address of the neighbour
forbiddenClaims.why: The record gives no detail of which neighbour

forbiddenClaims.claim: PayPal or India Post confirmed the delivery
forbiddenClaims.why: The tracking events are seller-entered (source SELLER); no carrier or PayPal record confirms them

forbiddenClaims.claim: Delivered to a neighbour on any date other than 2026-10-01
forbiddenClaims.why: The only such record is dated 2026-10-01; another date is a mismatch

forbiddenClaims.claim: Any specific partial refund amount, or that a partial refund is recommended
forbiddenClaims.why: The baseline never recommends PARTIAL_REFUND or proposes an amount: no policy field gives one and the partial-refund body is unverified

forbiddenClaims.claim: The parcel has not arrived (as a fact)
forbiddenClaims.why: Only the buyer message says this (REC-C865F2E150); it supports 'the buyer said', not the fact

notes: R7: the shipment and neighbour-delivery tracking support PROOF_OF_FULFILLMENT, so submit it and list the signature type as missing; the deadline is 72 hours away (not urgent). PARTIAL_REFUND is an allowed type, but the baseline never recommends it or proposes an amount (owner Q16).
